result:
Enemies now flash white when hit: `scripts/enemy.gd` gives each enemy its own `ShaderMaterial` on its Sprite2D (using `flash.gdshader`), and `hit()` sets `amount` to 1 and tweens it to 0 over 0.2s. The godotwright review reports no errors in `enemy.gd`, but I could not run the game here.

One behavior to know: an enemy killed by `hit()` is freed in the same call, so it won't visibly flash on the killing blow.
